purpose: Correct the raw-drift confound in prior random-rule factory screening by requiring conditional excess return relative to the contemporaneous same-session complement, while preserving strict 2024 discovery / untouched 2025 confirmation / sealed 2026 separation.
effect_definition: directional forward-return mean among selected rows minus directional forward-return mean among non-selected rows within the same optional session gate

confirmation_gate.serial_dependence: Bartlett/Newey-West HAC influence-series variance with lag=max(48,2*horizon)
confirmation_gate.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 5% across every 2024 discovery candidate; candidates not reaching HAC evaluation receive p=1

interpretation: A PASS is a statistically screened conditional phenomenon candidate set, not an executable strategy or profitable EA. Costs, signal overlap/trade mechanics, slippage, broker fidelity, clustering/redundancy and protected OOS remain downstream gates.
